{{wireless adapter |brand=Allnet |model=ALL0193 |revision=v1 |manuf=BroMax |manuf_model=UW250 |fcc_id=O6M-UW250 |if=USB |if_bus_version=1.1 |vendor_id=0b3b |device_id=1601 |chip1_brand=Intersil |chip1_model= |chip2_brand=Intersil |chip2_model= |802dot11_protocols=b }} <!--{{On at76c50x matrix}}--> The FCC ID is probably O6M-UW250 ([[BroMax UW250]]‎).
Device also references ID 0b3b:1601 with the same device description :("[[ZyXEL ZyAIR B-200]] Wireless LAN USB Adapter"). Unknown what the differences were between the units, if any.
Drivers reference the device as 0b3b:1602 for v2.5 and also 0b3b:1603 for v3.0 :(which appears to be used by the [[ZyXEL ZyAIR B-200]]). Device ID found in the ALL0193 (new) driver set on the Allnet website.
